rejected_candidates.candidate: ADI error estimate (3.6) and parameter formulas (3.7)-(3.9)
rejected_candidates.reason: The paper attributes these results to earlier references rather than proving them here.

The theorem is source-backed and unavailable in the compiled library, but a clean fixed-order formalization reduces mostly to outer-product and Gram-factor bookkeeping. Retaining full arbitrary parameter reordering would add substantial matrix inverse algebra, yet Theorem 6.1 provides a stronger, cleaner T3 whose complete spanning argument is developed in the paper.

The distinct-parameter case is a partial-fraction calculation close to Mathlib's general polynomial infrastructure, while the paper only says that the repeated-parameter expansion can be calculated and does not supply its proof.
Both are explicitly presented as well-known results with external references rather than newly proved results of this paper.
The paper explicitly omits their proofs.
These are experiments and qualitative conclusions rather than source-proved universal statements suitable for a task.

T1.decision: Skipped. The compiled NumStability set has no Lyapunov, ADI/CF-ADI, Krylov, rational-Krylov, partial-fraction resolvent, or shifted spanning theorem. Generic matrix and spectral helpers do not give one substantial paper-relevant shortcut.

T2.decision: Skipped. No proof in P37 needs at least two distinct substantial results from the compiled NumStability set. More directly relevant Lyapunov, Sylvester, and alternating-directions modules exist only as uncompiled frozen source and cannot be counted for condition L.

T3.decision: Selected Theorem 6.1, equations (6.3)-(6.4). Its proof combines dimension-n Krylov stabilization, shifted-generator equivalence, inverse-shift containment, all earlier and later indices, arbitrary consecutive windows, and independence from the original base vector, with no corresponding compiled NumStability theorem.

selection_policy: Use only conclusions whose statements and supporting derivations are present in this paper.
Do not turn cited well-known results or propositions with omitted proofs into tasks.
Do not count uncompiled Lyapunov, Sylvester, or alternating-directions source modules as available to condition L.
Keep the two-sided sequence, arbitrary starting index, and equality with the ordinary Krylov span in the selected theorem.
Assign tiers only after comparison with the complete frozen NumStability source, its importable compiled subset, and Mathlib.
